seriesName: OpenAI's publicly reported compute spending target through 2030, before and after its 2026 upward revision

points.label: OpenAI compute spend target through 2030, as reported Feb 2026 (Reuters via Yahoo Finance)
OpenAI compute spend target through 2030, as reported July 2026 (WSJ via Yahoo Finance)

notes: Both figures are OpenAI's own stated compute-spend target through 2030, republished by Yahoo Finance from two different wire sources (Reuters, then WSJ) roughly five months apart -- the second article itself states the $750B figure is 'up from roughly $600 billion earlier this year,' confirming these are the same measure at two points in time, not two different metrics. Both source pages are on finance.yahoo.com, satisfying the single-site rule. This only yields 2 dated points, presented here as a labelled before/after comparison pair (old target vs. revised target) rather than a 3+ point series, since no third same-site, same-metric figure with its own verifiable number could be found. The Nvidia '70% of demand' supply figure quoted in the day's bullet could not be paired here: no matching same-site bare-number 'demand' figure (only hedged phrasing like 'demand is much higher') was found to make a clean supply-vs-demand pair without violating the bare-number rule.
